source: Ashby's list of its MCP tools, https://docs.ashbyhq.com/ashby-mcp-server-beta ("Available tools", 2026-11-05): names only, in the research form. Ashby publishes no schemas or annotations; replace this file with a list saved from a signed-in server.

tools.name: search_records_by_name
tools.purpose: Resolve a name to a candidate, job, application or email template

tools.name: filter_records
tools.purpose: Find or count candidates, applications, jobs, job postings, openings, scheduled interviews or offers by criteria; costs 2 rate-limit units

tools.name: describe_object_fields
tools.purpose: Helper: the filterable fields of a record type, before filter_records

tools.name: get_record_details
tools.purpose: Full details of located jobs, job postings, applications, email templates, openings, scheduled interviews or offers

tools.name: get_candidate
tools.purpose: A candidate's profile: resume, interview feedback, emails, texts, notes, interview transcripts, referrals, follow-ups, form submissions

tools.name: get_upcoming_interviews
tools.purpose: The user's upcoming interviews: candidate, job, time, links

tools.name: get_interview_details
tools.purpose: Prep briefing for one interview: candidate background, resume summary, panel, hiring team

tools.name: get_interview_plan
tools.purpose: The stages of a job's or application's interview plan

tools.name: get_submitted_feedback
tools.purpose: Scorecard feedback the user personally submitted (never other interviewers')

tools.name: get_job_pipeline
tools.purpose: Candidate counts per stage for one or more jobs

tools.name: get_pending_tasks
tools.purpose: The user's pending tasks: scorecards owed, approvals, follow-ups, candidate reviews, survey requests

tools.name: search_product_docs
tools.purpose: Answers 'how do I' questions from Ashby's product docs, with links

tools.name: create_candidate
tools.purpose: Create a candidate with name and contact details

tools.name: add_note_to_candidate
tools.purpose: Draft a note on a candidate's profile for the user to confirm before saving; can reply to a note

tools.name: consider_candidate_for_job
tools.purpose: Create an application for a candidate at the first stage of a job's interview plan

tools.name: change_application_stage
tools.purpose: Move an application to another stage, including Archived (needs an archive reason; the stage's automatic activities run, such as an automated archive email to the candidate)

tools.name: submit_mcp_feedback
tools.purpose: Send feedback to the Ashby team when the server hits a limitation
